(SELECT 'OPERATION' AS source, id AS source_id, ticket_id, action, operator_id, operator_role, content, created_at FROM ticket_operation_logs WHERE 1 = 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'STATUS' AS source, id AS source_id, ticket_id, CONCAT('STATUS_', event) AS action, operator_id, NULL AS operator_role, CONCAT('状态变更：', COALESCE(from_status, '无'), ' → ', to_status, CASE WHEN remark IS NULL OR remark = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('（', remark, '）') END) AS content, created_at FROM ticket_status_history WHERE from_status IS NOT NULL ) a LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id = a.ticket_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.operator_id

where.if: AND (a.action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!')

SELECT CONCAT(a.source, ':', a.source_id) AS id, a.source, a.source_id, a.ticket_id, COALESCE(t.ticket_no, '-') AS ticket_no, a.action, a.operator_id, AS operator_name, COALESCE(a.operator_role, CASE WHEN a.operator_id IS NULL OR a.operator_id = 0 THEN 'SYSTEM' WHEN u.role = 2 THEN 'ADMIN' WHEN u.role = 1 THEN 'HANDLER' WHEN u.role = 0 THEN 'USER' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) AS operator_role, a.content, a.created_at FROM
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.source DESC, a.source_id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
